summary: A presentation-only navigation refactor exposes duplicated high-level test coupling while one browser check protects a distinct keyboard property.
kind: checked-in rendered artifact, verification plan, and offline oracle
planted: Product destinations and keyboard behavior are unchanged, but duplicated high-level coupling to navigation order and presentation selectors makes eighteen checks fail.

Pre-existing checks repeat destination expectations through incidental presentation selectors; a stable boundary can replace them, while one browser check uniquely observes rendered keyboard focus order.
Fixed destination examples come from the product contract and remain useful independent expectations. Their literal form does not make them defective.
absent_on_purpose: No live browser, framework, test ratio, fixed time budget, product-specific journey list, or model receipt. The retained rendered artifact stands in for browser output.
setup: Copy this directory into an empty owned scratch directory outside any repository and register cleanup before initialization.
Initialize Git and commit the retained files with the synthetic Fixture identity. Add no remote or network access.
end_state_signals: The final plan names the protected properties, repairs duplicated selector coupling, and retains the browser-only keyboard check without mechanically rewriting the high-level suite.
privacy: All navigation, checks, and product properties are synthetic.
